identityRule: Each Phase 7.1C quarantine retains its original source ID as the Phase 7.2 quarantine key; no source record is silently merged, deleted or promoted into geometry.

defaultGraphState.resolutionPolicy: A quarantine may be superseded only by an explicit later record that cites the original ID and independent evidence.

classificationRules.graphEffect: Do not create adjacency or route edges.
Keep as time-state metadata; do not create permanent architecture.
Assign unresolved container or possible-link only; traversal remains prohibited.
Do not authorize coordinates or dimensions.
Keep separate from conventional permanent geometry.

fallbackClass.graphEffect: Carry forward unchanged with navigation and geometry prohibited.
